cli.app_about: RootMyVivo-RS: Unlock-free temporary root & KernelSU orchestrator for vivo/iQOO devices (Rust)
cli.app_long_about: RootMyVivo-RS provides automated unlock-free root, dynamic KernelSU/SukiSU loading, and local ADB persistence for locked bootloader vivo/iQOO devices.
cli.check_about: Inspect device hardware, kernel version, and CVE-2026-43499 vulnerability status
cli.catalog_about: Fetch remote payload catalog and match available payloads for current device
cli.run_about: Execute unlock-free root and load KernelSU
cli.clean_about: Clean up temporary runtime files and logs on device
cli.history_about: View or manage local run history logs
cli.arg_serial: Target device ADB serial number (when multiple devices connected)
cli.arg_payload: Custom local preload.so path (ignore remote catalog)
cli.arg_ksu: Target KernelSU variant (sukisu, kernelsu, next, resukisu)
cli.arg_skip_ksu: Acquire temporary root only; skip KernelSU LKM driver loading
cli.arg_reboot_first: Reboot device first to ensure running with a pristine boot_id
cli.arg_force_payload: Skip payload identity gate and force deployment
cli.arg_payload_dir: Local payload directories for fallback matching when gate fails
cli.arg_dry_run: Parse and verify payload only; do not deploy or execute
cli.arg_manager_apk: Path to local manager APK on PC for offline ksud extraction
cli.arg_deep: Perform deep cleanup (remove sockets, old su, daemons, caches)
cli.probing_device: Probing ADB connection and device environment...
cli.gate_unsupported_desc: (Kernel version %{version} is not in supported range)
cli.no_payload_matched: No dedicated payload found in current catalog for this device.
cli.no_device_connected: (No ADB device connected, run `rmv check` to diagnose)
cli.cleaning_traces: Cleaning up temporary root traces on device...
cli.clean_deep_label: Deep cleanup mode (including leftover su/socket/daemon logs)
cli.cleaned_root: Temporary directories and leftovers cleaned up (with root).
cli.cleaned_shell: Cleaned temporary files with shell permissions.
